Evelyn — I can approve a conditional exception but need these controls in place before we finalize terms: 

1) Pilot period: first two invoices will be on Net-30 to establish payment behavior; thereafter convert to quarterly Net-90 for up to 3 quarters.
2) Security: customer to provide a purchase order and valid billing contact; we need procurement@bluehorizon.com on the PO.
3) Deposit: a refundable deposit equal to 15% of the first-quarter invoice to be collected up front and held in escrow until the second invoice is paid on schedule.
4) Late payment: 1.5% monthly late fee applied after the invoice past due date.
5) Credit-trigger: if the second invoice is >14 days late, we reserve the right to pause service until remittance or escrow draw.

If those controls are acceptable, I sign off from finance. Please work with Legal to capture the deposit/escrow language and the late-fee clause.

Naomi Feldman
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com

Thanks — legal is OK to proceed with the controls Naomi outlined, subject to two clarifications I want reflected in the MSA redline: 

- Payment security: escrow is acceptable, but we need explicit language that the escrow is limited to the deposit amount and not a waiver of customer obligations otherwise.
- Suspension / cure: add a 45-day cure period from the invoice date before Redwood may suspend non-critical services; critical security/production incidents get immediate escalation, not immediate suspension.

I'm attaching a targeted redline of the MSA with the deposit/escrow and late fee language (MSA_redline_BH.docx). We should not make broader concessions (no change to indemnity or data residency clauses).

Hi Samantha / Procurement team —

Thanks for the patience while we reviewed internally. Redwood can accommodate quarterly invoicing and Net-90 on a conditional basis for the pilot. Summary of agreed terms (pending PO and signed amendment):

- Pilot commercial: 3-month pilot (Q4) with a 7% one-time pilot discount.
- Billing cadence: single invoice per quarter; after pilot we will invoice quarterly.
- Payment terms: Net-90 from invoice date after pilot. For the pilot, the first two invoices will be Net-30 to establish payment history.
- Deposit: Blue Horizon to remit a refundable deposit equal to 15% of the first-quarter invoice. Redwood will hold the deposit in escrow per the attached instructions.
- Late payment: 1.5% monthly late fee applies after due date.
- Suspension policy: Redwood reserves the right to pause non-critical services after a 45-day cure period for unpaid invoices; critical production incidents follow the SLA escalation process.

Required next steps from Blue Horizon:
1) Provide purchase order referencing deal ID DL-2027-1187 and billing contact. (Template attached: BH_PO_template.pdf)
2) Sign the amendment / redline we sent (we included targeted MSA language for escrow and late fee). I can send a DocuSign packet if easier: https://redwoodinference.app/ds/DS-78B2K
3) Remit the 15% refundable deposit to the escrow account within 7 business days of signed amendment.

If you confirm these items, we'll process the discount and switch the billing cadence as requested. Happy to hop on a quick call if you'd like to walk procurement through the PO and escrow steps.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
